title: Exact Native/I3 review candidate R2, not installed contracts

TypedPublication.description: Typed publish Human binding companion, not the ordered history receipt; the exact new receipt shape is TypedHistoryReceipt.

BoundNotesProjection.description: Minimum display strings derived from the bound original row; absent cells null, numeric manual hints displayed as strings. Escape text; redact secrets/absolute paths. Never mutate raw cells or upgrade evidence.

owner_mapping.EX-S1: Case Intake + task_service + Source Owner, no separate Task truth

semantic_validators_required: Owner/principal/session/CSRF current at command; server derives actor and native source
same operation + same digest replays; different digest conflicts
Native task-origin index and Task creation must be same existing Task DB transaction
all SHA/path refs within appropriate native scope; no client owner override
confirm_type requires catalog member other than unknown and other note when other; defer_type requires null
profile conflict requires explicit reviewed reason; proposed dispositions await product/Owner confirmation
typed publication requires valid independent Case Approval, type decision and Human display authorization; old receipts unchanged
no Excel raw value promotes evidence, proof, media rights, style or compatibility
bound notes require live Reviewer grant and current exact Case/Attempt permission plus origin companion; no actor substitution or unrelated row scan
new origin-bearing worker task cannot dispatch before canonical companion and original submission ownership are complete
old R2 bytes and dispatch_model=false remain unchanged
preflight_sha256 binds exact principal/origin/source parameters/current original qualification inputs; changed source/permission invalidates before admission; not an approval
profile conflict correction appends formal decision only; immutable raw Excel suggestions are never edited
typed withdrawal checks current original withdrawal authority and exact prior publication, not renewed source/media/type eligibility; source revocation must not prevent safe withdrawal
same withdrawal operation replays the original receipt; stale parent cannot overwrite a newer publication

proposal_runtime_paths.publication: existing Shared Display owner directory, new version handled by original owner

open_product_decisions: unknown remains null until explicitly decided
profile/type conflict dispositions proposed, not frozen

authorization_record.source: latest direct user request in this chat
authorized_now: isolated tests with no paid model or business authority mutation
awaiting_independent_approval: EX-S1 exact native admission and persistence

task_admission_index_proposal.atomicity: Native Task and admission mapping inserted/linked in the same original Task DB transaction; canonical origin intent and companion required for dispatch; no approval authority
task_admission_index_proposal.replay: same principal/operation and exact digest -> exact mapped Task including terminal; changed input -> conflict; no latest-source task inference
task_admission_index_proposal.source_lock: original upload lock before DB transaction; no reentrant HTTP call

semantic_rules_not_expressible_by_shape_: All SourceRefs server-resolved under the role-specific canonical directory; reject traversal/symlinks/foreign scope, not just regex
Task IDs and Native input digests required for admitted/linked; no foreign Task IDs even in private-duplicate response
One original Native task/source admission transaction, original capacity limits and backup/source lock ordering
Other note must be non-whitespace; unknown never confirmed formal type; confirm must be confirmable member of exact current catalog
Current Reviewer grants for preview/write/read; immutable decision-time authorization evidence for historical committed receipts
Type confirmation only against stable original approved Case+Receipt+Attempt; primary import origin required when present in Task
TypedPublication read/write validates exact type/catalog/display/source/privacy/rights and original publication parent; Human confirmation mandatory
Withdraw does not require valid publish sources or new media permission; current legitimate withdrawal grant and exact history required
execution_claimed is conservative scheduler metadata, not proof of an external result; unknown never automatically re-dispatches
Only one new_origin_task mapping per Native Task; linked_owned_task never replaces its primary origin/payload or re-executes it

Typed public display.video_type is the confirmed catalog label; machine type ID remains in the exact TypeDecision and projection.video_type_id. Formal other note stays private, not automatically published

TypedHistoryReceipt publish sources resolves the immutable approved display/source-clearance snapshot and original validators, never client display sources. Withdrawal inherits historical Case/Approval hashes without requiring current publish eligibility
Type revoke uses exact historical type head/receipt evidence plus current legitimate grant; it does not require newly valid Case media or a publish preview

Bound notes are only the explicit V0.3 whitelist in BoundNotesProjection.notes, escaped/redacted display strings, absent=null; exclude media paths, provider references, supporting-document references and unrelated rows

Typed preview source_clearance_snapshot is an original Shared Owner immutable preview artifact; its exact byte SHA equals source_clearance_snapshot_sha256 and receipt sources. No new Case/source business authority

TypeDecisionInput revoke/defer uses historical expected Case/Approval hashes, not a demand that invalidated sources become publishable again; confirm requires current approved sources and non-null exact preview

hashing_rules.legacy_R2: Do not redefine file identities; resolve exactly via original R2 Readers and record_sha/bytes rules
hashing_rules.file_refs: SHA-256 of exact immutable file bytes; never compare a logical JSON digest as if it were a file SHA
hashing_rules.new_logical_digest: Original authorization digest convention: UTF-8 JSON sort_keys=true, ensure_ascii=false, separators=(comma,colon); finite typed values only
hashing_rules.self_digest_exclusion: NativePreview preflight_sha256 and TypedDisplayPreview preview_sha256 each digest the complete corresponding body with ONLY that own digest field omitted
hashing_rules.replay: Original prepared input/body bytes and source refs remain; no new timestamps, swapped media or recomputed replacement operation on replay
